description: Get the latest cryptocurrency news headlines and articles. Filter by keyword, coin ticker(s) (e.g. "btc,eth"), and language. Returns article title, description, link, source, publish date, category, and country. Example: crypto_news({ coin: "btc,eth", query: "etf" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NewsData.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

coin.description: Comma-separated coin ticker(s) to filter by, e.g. "btc,eth"

language.description: Language code to filter news by, e.g. "en", "es", "fr"

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search crypto news for, e.g. "etf", "halving"

name: crypto_news
title: Crypto News
